facts.text: Coffee seedlings are initially grown in shaded nurseries before being planted in permanent settings.

support.quote: Coffee plants usually start as seedlings in shaded nurseries, with specifical conditions to help them grow healthy and strong.

facts.text: Coffee cherries are harvested using either selective picking by hand or stripping methods.

support.quote: There are two main types of harvesting: Selective picking and Stripping.

facts.text: Green coffee seeds are transformed into brown beans through roasting machines.

support.quote: In roasting machines, generally referred to as coffee roasters, where the beans are kept moving continuously to prevent burning.
